nar.text: Due to the inconsistent weather during practice, Nuvolari tried a special rain deflector device above his wind shield.
When Italo Balbo lowered the checkered flag, Arcangeli took the lead ahead of Chiron. The start was a bit ragged since Varzi and Nuvolari moved before the start signal was given.
After completing the first lap, Arcangeli blasted past the finish, followed by Chiron and Varzi, all about a second apart.
After a short while Fagioli appeared, pressed hard by Nuvolari, who had started in the last row.
Nenzioni stops to change spark plugs.
Varzi passes Chiron for second; Arcangeli laps in a record 5m45.3s.
Chiron had obviously encountered a problem, which slowed his pace and he fell to third position while the storming Nuvolari, who had passed Fagioli, was just four seconds behind him.
Chiron's chase came to an end with a mechanical problem, when he retired on lap three.
Varzi, in car trouble, drops to fifth with a 6m31.0s lap.
Consequently Nuvolari inherited second place, just over 18 seconds behind the leader while Fagioli found himself in third position, followed by Bouriat.
Varzi stopped at his pit to quickly have a slipping clutch checked, then rejoined the race.
Bouriat is called in; Chiron takes over his Bugatti, 56 seconds behind Arcangeli.
On lap six Varzi stopped again at his pit where he retired with a burned out clutch.
Nuvolari passes Arcangeli for the lead; the Maserati stays 5.2 seconds behind.
Chiron in Bouriat's Bugatti drove again faster than both with a 5m50s lap, lowering the gap to 38.2s and closed up to just five seconds behind Fagioli, whose lap with the small Maserati was 5m59.6s.
Chiron passes Fagioli for third, 37.8 seconds behind Arcangeli.
As they passed the pits at the end of the eleventh lap, Arcangeli was back in the lead, but only by one fifth of a second.
On lap 13, Nuvolari drove a lap of 5m44.2s and passed Arcangeli whose time had slowed to 5m47.2s.
Chiron's lap time of 5m39.8s was not just a new lap record but faster than both of his opponents, which gained him 7.4 seconds and lowered the gap to the leader to 33.2s after 13 laps.
Nenzioni is out after 12 laps.
On lap 17, Nuvolari encountered trouble and fell behind with a lap of 6m15.4s.
Chiron overhauls Nuvolari and is 16.2 seconds behind Arcangeli.
On lap 18 Chiron drove another fast lap in 5m36.6s at 139.772 km/h
In the meantime Nuvolari nursed his sick Alfa Romeo along, crawling with a lap of 8m41.8s and falling behind Fagioli's Maserati to fourth position but still minutes ahead of von Morgen's Bugatti.
At the end of lap 19, as they passed the finish, Chiron followed Arcangeli like a shadow, one second behind.
Going into the last lap on the first right-hand turn after the grandstand, Chiron passed the Maserati and went into the lead.
On the last right turn before the finish, the Italian did a bold move and went left, on the outside past the Bugatti, building up a good lead.
Arcangeli wins, about 80 metres ahead of Chiron in Bouriat's Bugatti.
Fagioli retires on the last lap with a broken rear axle bearing; Nuvolari stops with a broken piston.
Von Morgen third, ahead of Biondetti, Campari, Caflisch, Tadini and Renzi.
